bounds_proof.request_payload: AudioCaptionRequest stores uint CaptionHashId, Vector3, AbsoluteUniversePosition, floats and byte state; no CaptionText reference field remains.
bounds_proof.caption_display_length: ResolveCaptionDisplayLength returns 0 if source/destination invalid, else min(captionText.Length, destination.Length). Therefore 0 <= displayLength <= destination.Length and displayLength <= captionText.Length.
bounds_proof.write_loop: WriteCaptionToBuffer loops i = 0; i < displayLength. Destination write index i is always less than destination.Length. ResolveCaptionDisplayChar receives i < displayLength <= captionText.Length.
bounds_proof.truncation: If captionText.Length > destination.Length and displayLength >= 3, ResolveCaptionDisplayChar returns dot for indexes displayLength-3 through displayLength-1. It does not append chars, so cursor/displayLength never grows.
bounds_proof.hash_loop: ComputeCaptionDisplayHash uses the same i < displayLength bound and does not allocate or mutate destination.
bounds_proof.fail_closed: Too-long caption text is truncated to destination.Length and last three visible chars are ASCII dots when capacity allows; no exception or resize path is introduced.
